core_principles: No generic centered layouts. Use severe asymmetry and the Tetris Grid.
Typography as art. Headings should be massive, kinetic, and structural.
Heavy use of negative space (Void Black) punctured by high-saturation Neon accents.
Glassmorphism done right: High blur (xl/2xl), low opacity, sharp 1px white/10 borders.
Real product/artist photography treated with clipping masks, spotlights, and grain overlays.

typography.custom_font_instructions: Use 'Clash Display' for headings (via Fontshare or local font face). If unavailable, fallback to 'Outfit' with extremely tight tracking.

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-[10vw] sm:text-7xl lg:text-8xl font-black uppercase tracking-tighter leading-[0.85]
hierarchy.h2_section: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold uppercase tracking-tight leading-none
hierarchy.eyebrow_mono: font-mono text-xs md:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-neon_cyan

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy: p-12, p-16, p-24, p-32. Elements must have extreme breathing room.

grid_system.bento_tetris: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 lg:gap-12

spacing_and_layout.section_padding: py-24 md:py-32 lg:py-40 px-6 md:px-12 lg:px-24

hero.layout: Min-h-screen, sticky/parallax background image. Content overlays via z-index.
hero.typography_reveal: Masked line-by-line reveal using Framer Motion (overflow-hidden wrapper, text slides up).
hero.overlay: bg-gradient-to-b from-void_black/40 via-void_black/60 to-void_black. DO NOT blanket the whole image heavily.
hero.parallax_instruction: Use Framer Motion useScroll and useTransform on the background image for a subtle y-axis drift.

navbar.style: Crystal Glassmorphism. backdrop-blur-xl bg-void_black/40 border-b border-white/10.
navbar.interaction: Sticky top, changes opacity/blur on scroll.
navbar.mobile: Fullscreen menu with staggered link reveal.

bottom_player.layout: Fixed bottom, full width (or floating pill shape on desktop).
bottom_player.visualizer: Animated equalizer bars (CSS animation scaling Y-axis based on random delays or actual audio data mock).

cards.track_card: Glassmorphism base, group hover scales up the cover art slightly, reveals play button overlay. 1px border-white/5.
cards.event_card: List view or dense grid. Large date in mono font, prominent venue name. Hover state applies subtle laser_purple glow to border.
cards.service_card: Minimalist, flat tinted_grey background. Icon uses neon_cyan or electric_magenta.

marquee.style: Slow editorial drift. Massive outlined text (text-transparent stroke) or solid mono text.

motion.scroll: lenis (smooth scrolling setup required at root level)
motion.page_transitions: Fade in and slide up (y: 20 -> 0) on route change.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building an Awwwards-level site. Do not use generic, boring, standard layouts. Everything must feel directed, like a film.
Implement `@studio-freight/react-lenis` for smooth scrolling in the main App wrapper.
Use Framer Motion extensively: every section should have a `whileInView` scroll reveal.
For the hero, implement a masked typography reveal. Wrap text lines in a div with `overflow-hidden`, and animate the text `y` from `100%` to `0`.
Never use `transition: all`. Target specific properties. Do NOT center text globally.
Use the 'Clash Display' font if possible (via CDN or local), fallback to 'Outfit' for headings. DO NOT USE INTER.
The sticky bottom player must always be visible but visually unobtrusive until hovered/interacted with.
Ensure all interactive elements have a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='play-track-button'`).
For Glassmorphism, do not use fully transparent backgrounds. Use `bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10` to ensure depth.
Implement a custom animated equalizer for the music player (using a flex container of small vertical divs scaling y-axis infinitely).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant emoji characters for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx
